request: A user directory that cannot be read, or a symbolic link that points back at a folder already being walked, must be reported as one path and let the rest of the plan continue, instead of aborting the plan or looping.

defects.description: Own-history fix 92e0a7d85a (2026-10-06): fix(sync): report unreadable and cyclic user paths instead of aborting the plan

trigger.input:
printf %s '' | base64 -d > internal/sync/sync_foreign_test.go
if go test -count=1 -run '^(TestSyncSkipsSymlinkCyclesInUserSkills|TestSyncReportsAnUnreadableUserFolderAndContinues|TestSyncStillRefusesAnUnreadableSkillsFolder)$' ./internal/sync >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo probe: pass; else echo probe: fail; fi

defects.why_missed: The project's own suite at the parent commit never exercised this input; the fix commit added the test that does.
